posts.angle: AI adoption creates more recurring subscriptions that need a reliable payment layer
posts.copy:
AI tool adoption keeps growing.

A near-autonomous AI chemist improves a challenging reaction in medicinal chemistry Teams move faster when payment setup does not slow subscriptions, ads, or cross-border checkout.
